question: Is the data in CoVoST annotated for dialect?
title: CoVoST: A Diverse Multilingual Speech-To-Text Translation Corpus
answer_rationale: Text 2 and Text 5 mention that CoVoST includes over 10 accents in French and German development/test sets and that a large portion of sentences are spoken in multiple accents for French, German, Dutch, and Spanish, indicating dialectal variation is annotated.
